title: The Last Soundcheck
opening: The venue sound drops just before the premiere.
ending: The house hears the first breath

beats.line: I hear the projector motor. Give me a minute at the patch bay.

beats.reason: foyer signal stands at 12/100. This move gains 30 points there.

beats.line: The foyer has a projector. Give me the people stuck outside.

beats.line: There. Try the house speakers again, from the top.

beats.line: I lost the last word from the aisle. Make that card bigger.

beats.line: I can carry the scene on faces. Put the first title over black.

beats.line: There are coats on every chair out here. They're waiting for your picture.
